title: RTL Introduction
description: Understand the philosophy of React Testing Library.

data.text: **React Testing Library (RTL)** is a testing utility that encourages testing components the way users interact with them. It focuses on behavior over implementation.

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Find elements the way users would
data.takeaway: RTL helps you write tests that give confidence in your UI.

data.title: Test a Button Component
data.description: Write a test that verifies a button renders and responds to clicks.
